command: cd /code && Rscript -e "rmarkdown::render(input='manuscript.Rmd', output_dir='../results', clean=TRUE)" > /tmp/render.out 2> /tmp/render.err; status=$?; echo EXIT:$status; echo '--- STDOUT ---'; sed -n '1,220p' /tmp/render.out; echo '--- STDERR ---'; sed -n '1,260p' /tmp/render.err; ls -la /results; ls -la ../results || true
